pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Small, irregularly polygonal and sub-circular regions with softened pixel gradients at the edges. Patches on the flank and lower neck exhibit significant textural elevation, appearing as raised nodules rather than flat color fields.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected grid of light-pigmented interstitial pathways. The pathways are consistently thin in pixel width, forming a continuous topological graph with primarily tripartite junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged, high-frequency 1D contour along the dorsal neck line, consistent with a short, upright mane. The silhouette shows low-amplitude serrations against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive textural disruption across the upper flank and dorsal ridge, characterized by numerous hyper-pigmented, raised nodular protrusions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread distribution of raised, circular skin lesions/nodules across the visible torso and neck, particularly concentrated on the darker pelage patches.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant topographic skin irregularity resulting in a distinct 'bumpy' surface profile across the entire visible lateral aspect.
